images.title: Ten strokes make one heel
images.purpose: Shows regrouping in Egyptian addition: 15 strokes become 1 heel and 5 strokes.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Before and after: a row of strokes on top with ten of them ringed, a downward arrow, and the regrouped symbols below.
images.exact_structure: Top: exactly 15 vertical strokes in a row, labelled 15 strokes; the first 10 are ringed together in amber (#E69F00). One dark arrow points down, labelled 10 make 1. Bottom: one heel (upside down U shape) in teal (#0072B2), labelled 1 heel, and beside it exactly 5 vertical strokes, labelled 5 strokes. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec

images.takeaway: When adding, every 10 of one symbol become 1 of the next, the same rule at every step.
images.description: Shows regrouping in Egyptian addition: 15 strokes become 1 heel and 5 strokes.
images.context: Worked example: 87 + 78 gives 15 heels and 15 strokes, regrouped to 1 coil, 6 heels, 5 strokes = 165.

image_decisions.why: Regrouping ten into one is the heart of base addition and shows clearly as a before and after.
